summary: Completed backend + frontend testing of SNC v2 Co-Parent Comparison feature. Created new pytest module (18 tests) covering link creation, consent flow, category filter, PDF, revoke/withdraw, and all 3 safety guardrails. Discovered CRITICAL bug: safety guardrails were completely inoperative (fail-open) because _latest_safety_level() read a non-existent top-level 'level' field from safety_assessments docs while the actual data is nested under 'result.level'. Fixed in-place (trivial data-access bug). After fix, all 18 comparison API tests pass + 15 existing SNC v2 unit/integration tests pass (regression clean). Frontend verified in Chromium: compare hub renders, non-existent partner surfaces error, invite to parent2 creates share, view page renders 29 items with alignment pills, filter chips show Educational/Psychological disabled when only medical is shared, PDF download button present, snc2-open-compare button present on assessment page, snc2-report-open-compare present after report generation, landing page situation-special-needs testid confirmed.

critical.issue: SAFETY GUARDRAIL FAIL-OPEN (fixed by testing agent): _latest_safety_level() in snc2_comparison_routes.py used projection {'level':1} and doc.get('level'), but safety_assessments store level under 'result.level'. Result: level was always None so BLOCKING_SAFETY_LEVELS check never fired. Any parent with a live level-1/2 Safety Assessment could still create/consent-to/view a comparison — the exact scenario the feature is supposed to block. Fixed to read {'result':1} and (doc.get('result') or {}).get('level'). All 3 safety guardrail tests now pass. Main agent should code-review the fix.

rca of the issue: RCA: In snc2_comparison_routes.py, _latest_safety_level() projected {'_id':0,'level':1} and read doc.get('level'). But safety_assessment_routes.py stores the doc with structure {..., 'result': {'level': N, ...}, ...} — 'level' is nested, not top-level. The projection therefore returned {'_id':...} only, doc.get('level') returned None, and the BLOCKING_SAFETY_LEVELS membership check (`None in {1,2}`) is False. Consequence: creator, consent, and view guardrails all silently skipped. Reproduction: POST /api/safety-assessment with s1_q1=yes (level 1) then POST /api/snc2/compare/link — before fix returned 200; after fix returns 403 with the safety copy. Mitigation: changed projection to {'result':1} and read (doc.get('result') or {}).get('level'). Verified with 3 dedicated tests covering all 3 guardrail stages.
